answer: You kicked off the year in January at Titan Forge Gym on Kepler Street — the 5am opening and the always-free squat racks before six were the whole appeal. By July a shoulder that had been complaining for about six weeks took heavy pressing off the table, so on your physio's advice you let that membership lapse and moved to Blue Lagoon Aquatic Centre for the 50m pool plus its little dryland band-and-cable area. Then in November, with the shoulder basically healed and laps driving you up the wall, a mate took you bouldering twice, you were hooked, and you joined Vertigo Climbing Collective — beginner technique class on Tuesdays already booked.
